tools.name: search_acquirers
tools.description: Search UK card-payment acquirers and processors in the MerchantHQ Card Acquirer Index. Filter by free-text query, acquirer tier, or sales channel. Returns factual terms (headline rate, settlement timing, contract length, channels) plus regulatory identifiers where we found them on the FCA register o

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_acquirers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search UK card-payment acquirers and processors in the MerchantHQ Card Acquirer Index. Filter by free-text query, acquirer tier, or sales channel. Returns factual terms (headline rate, settlement timing, contract length, channels) plus regulatory identifiers where verified. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
